_note: DEMO BINGO CARD. Uniform 5x5, because gametypes/bingo.json sets gridConstraints.uniformRows true and a ragged bingo board is a validation failure (spec §4.2). Bingo needs no point values: bingo.json requires only `prompt`, its scoring model is `none`, and its win condition is a completed pattern. So there is no valueLadder anywhere in this file, and that is correct, not an omission. Squares are general-knowledge callables the host reads out; all public-domain subject matter.
title: Quiz Board Engine Demo — Trivia Bingo

columns._note: The centre square of a 5x5 card is cell key "2:2" — column index 2, row index 2 (plan Q7, column first, both zero-based). flags.preMarked true means it starts in its terminal state, which for bingo's two-state lifecycle is `marked`: the classic free space (spec §4.1).
